summary: Kamada Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching Exhibit 99.1, its October 5, 2026 response to an SEC comment letter dated September 25, 2026 concerning the Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. The staff questioned inventory capitalization for pre-approval commercial production; Kamada confirmed no such costs were capitalized in 2025 or 2024 and agreed to expand future Note 3 disclosures. The filing also notes correspondence was mistakenly sent to the Israel Securities Authority. No transaction, price, stake, or advisor is involved; purely routine accounting-comment correspondence with no deal terms.
